    How it works

    Format and usage limits

    Up to 30 images; 8 MiB each and 64 MiB combined original file size. Each image may have up to 16 million pixels and an 8192 px edge. Supports static PNG and 8-bit baseline / progressive JPEG. No APNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, HEIC or CMYK JPEG. Browser support and available memory vary; images within these limits may still fail.

    Output is limited to 16 million pixels, 8192 px per edge and a 64 MiB PNG. Images are not cropped or enlarged; transparency appears white. This is a thumbnail overview, not a full-quality photo archive. Originals are not modified.

    Where are the complete filenames?

    Download the filename index as well as the PNG. Each index line contains a number, a Tab and the complete filename as a JSON string. Newlines and control characters are escaped. Numbers follow the current order; filenames need not be unique.

    Will orientation and colors match exactly?

    The tool reads supported EXIF orientation before browser decoding and stops on dimension mismatches. Orientation, colors and fonts may still vary by browser. Inspect the preview. Original photo metadata is not copied; color or DPI fidelity is not guaranteed.

    Does cancelling or clearing securely erase data?

    No. Cancellation stops further work but cannot interrupt native decoding immediately; its result is discarded when it finishes. Clearing releases page references, not downloaded files. Browser or operating-system memory erasure is not guaranteed.

    Discard current work?

    Images and undownloaded results will be cleared and cannot be restored. Cancel and download first if you want to keep them.
